

# Information for Executors

Royal Star & Garter is deeply grateful to all those supporters who remember the charity in their Will. Gifts in Wills are vital to our work, helping to provide the highest standard of specialist care for veterans and their partners, living with disability or dementia.

We appreciate the time and work involved in taking on the role of Executor, and hope that the following information will be helpful.

**Please contact our Legacy Team if you have any questions:  
Phone 020 8481 7676 or email [legacies@starandgarter.org](mailto:legacies@starandgarter.org)**

## Getting in touch

Please do let us know if Royal Star & Garter has been remembered in a Will. We understand that it may be some time before you are in a position to fulfil the bequest, however knowing about this kind gift does help us to plan for the future.

We would be most grateful for the following details:

- The full name and address of the person who has made a gift in their Will
- Their date of death
- A copy of the Will (or the extract that mentions the gift).

Where Royal Star & Garter has been left a share of residue, we would be grateful for a full copy of the Will, a schedule of estate assets and liabilities once this is available, and estate accounts at the end of the administration. Please do contact us if you have any questions about this.

## Payment information

- Please make all cheques payable to “The Royal Star & Garter Homes”.
- Please include a covering note with the name of the estate and your contact details so that we can provide a receipt for your records.

Cheques may be sent by post to:

**Legacy Team, Royal Star & Garter, 15 Castle Mews, Hampton, Middlesex, TW12**

**Please do get in touch if you would like to pay by bank transfer and we would be glad to provide our details securely.**
